findings.replay_sampling_generator: Initialized from saved seed; current torch.Generator state is not serialized.
findings.environment_and_rollout: Runner resume invokes actor.load_checkpoint; environment and rollout workers are initialized afresh.
findings.update_step: Starts at zero in a new SAC actor; current critic_actor_ratio and target_update_freq are both1, so its phase does not alter their update schedule.
findings.gradients: Tensor .grad fields are not in model state dict. Upstream clips over the model while optimizers clear their own parameter gradients; prior CPU audit shows saved runtime gradients can affect clipping.
findings.panda_action_preparation: prepare_actions_for_maniskill returns raw actions unchanged for panda policies; ONNX evaluation passes the same normalized four-vector to the controller.
